summary: Riding a minecart cluster into a wall freezes the game
description: Derailed Minecarts that are clustered together often keep their movement speed, which is due to another bug (). In some cases (with the Minecart Improvements experiment enabled) if such clusters of minecarts are ridden by the player and collide with blocks, the screen goes black and the game stops working. It then has to be terminated manually. Steps to reproduce (or use the link below for a more reliable method): - Place around 20 to 30 minecarts on a normal rail. - Push the minecarts. They should now start to move off the rail, keeping their velocity. - Ride one of the minecarts in the cluster. - Wait until it collides into blocks (2 blocks high is best). Water like in the attached videos isn t needed. This is not very reliable, so a few attempts may be needed. Alternatively, the attached world ( ) can be used to reproduce the bug: - Open the world. - Walk into the minecart cluster. - Ride one of the minecarts in the cluster. - Wait until it collides into the wall and locks the game.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Place around 20 to 30 minecarts on a normal rail.
4. Push the minecarts to start moving them off the rail, allowing them to keep their velocity.
5. Ride one of the minecarts in the cluster.
6. Wait until the minecart collides with blocks (2 blocks high is best).
7. Observe that the screen goes black and the game stops working, requiring manual termination.
Observed Behavior:
When a player rides a cluster of derailed minecarts that are moving at high velocity and collides with a solid block (preferably a wall that is at least 2 blocks high), the game experiences a critical freeze. This occurs specifically when the Minecart Improvements experiment is enabled. Upon collision, the screen turns black, and the game becomes unresponsive, requiring the player to terminate the game process manually. The issue seems to be linked to the interaction between the clustered minecarts maintaining their velocity and the collision detection system when the player is riding one of the minecarts. 

The following behaviors have been observed:
- The collision with the wall does not result in a normal dismount or bounce-back effect; instead, it leads to a complete freeze of the game interface.
- The player's character remains visibly seated in the minecart, but all game functions cease, including the ability to open menus or interact with the game world.
- The freeze occurs consistently after several attempts, indicating a reproducible bug under the specified conditions.

This issue is critical as it disrupts gameplay and requires a forceful shutdown of the game, potentially leading to loss of unsaved progress.
Expected Behavior: When riding a cluster of minecarts, the player should be able to move freely and safely without experiencing any game freezes or crashes upon colliding with blocks. Instead of the game locking up and displaying a black screen, the player should be ejected from the minecart smoothly, allowing for normal gameplay to continue without interruption. This expected behavior should function consistently, even with the Minecart Improvements experiment enabled.
